title: Emil Kowalski and Claude Code launch design tools to polish AI websites #emilkowalski #claudecode
description:
Emil Kowalski introduced three key design skills that transform AI-built websites from generic to professional. These include adding real motion with proper easing to replace flat animations, using Impeccable’s commands for refined typography and layout polish, and applying Taste to teach AI models better design principles.

These tools address the common issues of AI-generated sites such as overused gradients, the Inter font, and lack of intentional motion, significantly enhancing user interface quality without extensive manual effort. The approach optimizes design workflows by embedding refined visual standards directly into AI-assisted development.

This innovation meets growing demand for polished, modern web interfaces created rapidly with AI, helping developers deliver more credible, visually engaging digital products. It represents a shift towards hybrid human-AI collaboration in design refinement.
